fieldRules.title: Field exceptions
fieldRules.description: Hidden fields are omitted. Forced fields retain their name when empty

format.title: Display format
format.description: Control attribute layout, date, checkbox, and long-text presentation. List layouts support regular and container blocks with grid or horizontal compact waterfall arrangements; list items leave room for the native bullet or number marker.
format.multiColumn: Adapt to available width with multiple columns
format.listHint: List-only options. Above and below lists track container block size changes automatically; waterfall mode packs fields by content width. Capsule and accent styles follow the field color palette.
format.listProTooltip: List layouts are a Pro Beta feature
format.inlineEditProTooltip: Inline editing is a Pro feature

appearance.title: Label appearance
appearance.description: Choose text and background colors by field type. Value overrides are for exceptional values only

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Control whether the plugin shows SiYuan toast messages

license.title: Pro license
license.description: Pro is a perpetual purchase tied only to your SiYuan account ID. It works on all devices signed in to this account.
license.supportHint: For questions about Pro licensing, contact the author via email.
license.placeholder: Paste the authorization code received after purchase
license.verifyFailed: Authorization code verification failed. Check the code and current account.

status.unconfigured: This build has no verification key
status.unsupported: This SiYuan version cannot verify licenses

trial.title: Pro trial
trial.description: Try Pro features free for 7 days. Each SiYuan account can activate the trial once.

status.missing-profile: Missing SiYuan account ID or user name
status.unavailable: Trial is not configured in this build

pinnedDatabases.title: Slash command databases
pinnedDatabases.description: Each database listed here becomes its own / command that adds the block to that database directly, with no further selection. The command targets the block under the cursor, or the nearest container block (list item, super block, quote, callout) wrapping it.
pinnedDatabases.empty: Not configured yet; no / command is registered.

disShow.title: Document block fields
disShow.description: Enter the field types to display (mSelect, number, date, text, template, mAsset, relation, rollup, block, lineNumber, checkbox, phone, url, email, created, updated). Leave blank to show all supported fields.

disShowBlock.title: Regular block fields
disShowBlock.description: Enter the field types to display (mSelect, number, date, text, template, mAsset, relation, rollup, block, lineNumber, checkbox, phone, url, email, created, updated). Leave blank to show all supported fields.

hiddenFields.title: Hidden field names
hiddenFields.description: Comma-separated field names to hide, for example: Password, Private Notes, Internal Remarks.
hiddenFields.logCleared: Hidden fields cleared; all fields will be shown.

dateFormat.title: Date display format
dateFormat.description: Select how date fields are formatted.

checkboxStyle.title: Checkbox style
checkboxStyle.description: Choose how checkbox fields are rendered.

forceShowFields.title: Force display fields
forceShowFields.description: Comma-separated field names to display even when their value is empty.
forceShowFields.logCleared: Force display fields cleared; placeholders disabled.

maxDisplayLength.title: Max display length
maxDisplayLength.description: Maximum characters to display before showing an ellipsis. Range: 10-200.
maxDisplayLength.rangeWarning: Display length should be between 10 and 200 characters. Reset to default (30).

fieldColorMap.title: Field text color (JSON)
fieldColorMap.description: Customize text colors for each field type. Supported: mSelect, number, date, text, mAsset, relation, rollup, block, lineNumber, checkbox, phone, url, email, created, updated.

fieldBgColorMap.title: Field background color (JSON)
fieldBgColorMap.description: Customize background colors for each field type (lighter colors recommended).

fieldValueColorMap.title: Field value colors (JSON)
fieldValueColorMap.description: Override colors by specific values. Format: { "value": "#textColor" } or { "value": { "color": "#textColor", "bg": "#background" } }.

previewColorDemo.title: Preview
previewColorDemo.description: Preview the current type/background/value colors. Updates automatically.
previewColorDemo.priorityHint: Priority: Value colors > Type text color / Type background color

autoLoadedInterval.title: Auto refresh interval (seconds)
autoLoadedInterval.description: Interval for automatically triggering loaded(). 0 = off; >=5 enables refresh (values <5 are raised to 5).

enableAttrObserver.title: Enable attribute view observer
enableAttrObserver.description: Detect new native attribute view nodes (.protyle-attr--av) and inject custom display automatically when missing our mirror element. Disable if causing performance issues.
